summary: FB Financial Corp completed a $125 million offering of 6.625% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036, issued under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust, with KBW as sole underwriter. The notes pay 6.625% semi-annually until October 1, 2031, then Three-Month Term SOFR plus 205 basis points quarterly through maturity. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes, including capital infusions to bank subsidiary FirstBank. This is a routine shelf takedown under an effective Form S-3ASR, not a special situation; watch for redemption optionality beginning 2031 and regulatory capital treatment.
